messages.content: 去夏威夷旅遊的最佳月份是什麼？

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
在夏威夷，最佳旅遊時間通常被認為是 **四月到五月** 和 **九月到十月**。這兩個時段結合了相對溫暖、乾燥且風景宜人的天氣，以及比旺季（六月至八月）更低的人潮和較合理的價格。

| 時期 | 天氣 | 人潮 | 價格 |
|------|------|------|------|
| 四月–五月 | 溫度約 24–28°C，降雨量少 | 中等偏低 | 比旺季略便宜 |
| 六月至八月 | 溫度 26–30°C，偶爾有午後雷陣雲 | 旺季高峰 | 飯店與機票價格最高 |
| 九月–十月 | 溫度 25–29°C，降雨量減少 | 中等偏低 | 與四月–五月相近 |

如果你想避開人潮並節省預算，建議選擇四月或九月；若你不介意人多但想享受最熱的海灘氛圍，六七八月則是最適合的旺季。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "去夏威夷旅遊的最佳月份是什麼？" (What is the best month to travel to Hawaii?). We need to answer. The user wants the best month to visit Hawaii. We can provide an answer based on typical tourist advice: best months are April-May and September-October, when weather is good and crowds lower. Also mention peak season June-August.
